pr_body:
Fixes #21502

Function `get_cert_by_subject_ex()` (crypto\x509\by_dir.c) uses function `X509_STORE_lock()` to lock the store, but the result of `X509_STORE_lock()` execution is not checked, although it may fail.

Added `X509_STORE_lock()`() check result.
pr_comments: This pull request is ready to merge
Squashed and merged to master, 3.1, and 3.0 branches. Thank you for your contribution.

issue_context.title: No result check of X509_STORE_lock()

review_comments:
What happens if this fails, and so we don't re-sort the objects? Will that lead to failures later? (i.e. is "sorted" a required invariant?). If that is the case, we should probably set `ok = 0` here if the lock fails.

However, if "sorted" is just an optimisation, we don't need to set `ok = 0`
The sorting is an optimisation.  It's avoiding O(n²) performance.  So what is here is correct.
